newsitem.title: USA: Panthers files for six mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Panthers files for six mln share offering.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc said it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to raise money by selling six million shares of its Class A common stock to the public.
The company, controlled by successful consolidator Wayne Huizenga, said shareholders who have received shares in connection with acquisitions may also sell shares in the offering.
The company said it will use the money it raises to finance future acquisitions, pay down debt, provide additional working capital for general corporate purposes.
The offering is being underwritten by Donaldson, Lufkin, and Jenrette, Raymond James Inc, and Allen and Company.
The company also said it would buy the luxury Registry hotel in Naples, Fla., for $75 million in cash and 980,000 shares of stock.
The stock was off 1/4 to 23 in early trading Wednesday. It currently trades on the Nasdaq but will begin trading on the NYSE under the symbol PAW.N on Friday July 11.
